mechanism.claim: When BTC spot's share of combined Binance spot and USD-M perpetual base volume rises into its causal upper tail, same-direction completed-hour spot and perpetual price movement is cash-sponsored rather than leverage-only. Joint BVOL and DVOL expansion confirms a new volatile price-discovery regime whose direction should relay for six hours.
mechanism.side: common sign of completed spot and perpetual returns
mechanism.why_distinct: SPVIR uses hourly base-volume participation across cash and perpetual markets. SLVCR required partial price transmission and no participation measure. CSPR used signed flow coherence, execution centroids, and perpetual flow rejection at five-minute resolution. VGSQF used stablecoin quote-book flow topology rather than spot/perpetual participation.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: cash participation share fused with dual crypto implied-volatility ignition is absent from Gross9

clock.sources: 60 exact BTCUSDT interval=1m rows from bars_binance_spot and bars_binance
clock.participation: spot base volume/(spot base volume+perpetual base volume), denominator positive
clock.participation_tail: current share >= strictly-prior 720h q75 with 672 valid observations
clock.direction_agreement: spot and perpetual hour_close/hour_open-1 have the same nonzero sign
clock.volatility_ignition: normalized completed-hour BVOL and DVOL bodies are both strictly positive
clock.trigger: false-to-true onset with prior source-valid consecutive hour
clock.reservation: global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only for later PnL
